clips.title: The story
paras: Razormane warbands strike Horde supply lines from Thorn Hill, east of the Crossroads. The fortified quilboar camp holds the high ridges between Durotar and the Barrens interior.

Thorn Hill overlooks the roads between Durotar and the Crossroads. The Razormane gather here with hunters, trained wolves, and geomancers who shape the earth. Elder Mystic Razorsnout guides the quilboar as their attacks on Horde supply caravans grow bolder. The camp sits close to vital routes, making it one of the Crossroads guards' most immediate threats in the central savanna.
